name: i.safe MOBILE IS360.2
statusNote: i.safe MOBILE has moved it to the archive section of its range, but distributors still list it. Check availability before ordering.
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS360.2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) feature phone from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It uses a proprietary OS (no Google Play), with a user-replaceable battery.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
limitations: May be near the end of its life: check availability before ordering
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
